expression: ( $r := business[source = 'cairn.run'].value; $g := business[source = 'cairn.gaps'].value; { 'key': key, 'phase': $r.status, 'availableActions': $r.status = 'WAITING_HUMAN' ? [ { 'type': 'ReviewDecide', 'enabled': true } ] : $r.status = 'PLANNING' or $r.status = 'RUNNING' ? [ { 'type': 'ContinueRun', 'enabled': true } ] : [], 'pending': $r.status = 'WAITING_HUMAN' ? [ { 'kind': 'human-review' } ] : $r.status = 'WAITING_MODEL' ? [ { 'kind': 'model-release' } ] : [], 'lastOutcome': null, 'body': { 'goal': $r.goal, 'stage': $r.stage, 'planRound': $r.planRound, 'outcome': $r.outcome, 'unresolvedGaps': $count($g.gaps[status = 'OPEN' or status = 'PLANNED' or status = 'IN_PROGRESS']), 'progressCounters': $r.progressCounters, 'waitingReason': $r.waitingReason, 'pins': $r.pins } } )
